macros.name: citeall
macros.doc: The command \citeall creates a “full citation”, showing the author, year, and number of the citation.

macros.name: citealn
macros.doc: The commands \citealn{⟨keys⟩} is the alternative \citenum command: it puts square brackets around its argument.

macros.name: multibibliographystyle
macros.doc: Define the bibliographystyle for the corresponding list.

macros.name: nmbibLink
macros.doc: The clickable links themselves are created with the help of the command \nmbibLink{⟨citation⟩}{⟨type⟩}{⟨text⟩}.

macros.name: nmbibSetBiblabel
macros.doc: The command \nmbibSetBiblabel{⟨type⟩}pattern is used to set the format of the label in the reference list of the given type.

macros.name: nmbibSetCiteall
macros.doc: The format of the \citeall and \citeall* macros can be changed by the command \nmbibSetCiteall{⟨pattern⟩}, where {⟨pattern⟩} sets the citation format.
